question.text: Which of the following is TRUE about the books of accounts of a Category I/II AIF?

answer.text: They shall be audited annually by a qualified auditor
They are audited only at the time of winding up
They are audited by SEBI directly

explanation.text: The Logic: The books of accounts of Category I and Category II AIFs must be audited annually by a qualified auditor. The Trap: Treating audit as optional, limiting it to wind-up, or assigning it to SEBI directly all contradict the annual-audit rule. Note: Source page 85 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
